hypothesis: Validation-only diagnosis: BF16 full/incremental discrepancies reflect finite-precision effects; assess their effect on target log probabilities against FP32 without redefining or passing the failed original BF16 gate.
baseline: Same locked P1/P2/P4 checkpoint in FP32, full teacher-forced forward, SDPA.
intervention: Same checkpoint, token sequence and SDPA backend: compare BF16 full and cached incremental paths with FP32 full and cached paths. No weight updates.
dataset: Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-2-raw-v1 at b08601e04326c79dfdd32d625aee71d232d685c3; same locked P1/P2/P4 models and HF LFS hashes in locks.json and configs/model-sources.json.
split: Validation only. Two existing first 1024-token blocks for loss; first 64 tokens of each block with prefill lengths 1 and 32 for cache diagnosis. Do not read or score test split in this task.
primary_metric: For every model/path/sequence: max/mean/p99 absolute logit error and target log-probability difference versus the corresponding FP32 reference; per-block token-weighted BF16-minus-FP32 NLL.
decision_rule: SUCCEEDED means complete finite diagnostic evidence and implemented safety/analysis checks, not acceptance of the r3 smoke gate or the scientific hypothesis. Preserve and report BF16 <=0.03 pass/fail unchanged. Report FP32 residuals and every position, no new acceptance threshold selected from observed BF16 maxima. GPT reviews the new evidence before any explicit protocol revision or full-test task.
controls: This task is designed but not launched by the r3 review session. Before later execution verify absence of this run's service/processes and record cumulative project budget. This is a validation/code repair task, not a fourth preparation/download attempt.

Reuse the already complete locked remote checkpoints. No downloads or environment reinstall needed. No local weights. If a file fails hash verification, stop and report corruption rather than adding a preparation retry.

Before creating each GPU model (including tiny and diagnostics), enforce free >=20GiB and utilization <=10% on GPU-REDACTED. Keep the 16GiB allocator cap and measure actual process memory; do not reinterpret free-memory requirement as a guideline or affect other processes.

Use a systemd user service with RuntimeMaxSec=1800 and KillMode=control-group; wrapper <=1740s. No new long task without a real listener using --fetch-artifacts --execute --session-id SESSION-REDACTED, never --last.

Freeze and commit implementation before execution; preserve code/run/result SHAs separately. Keep raw arrays and logs outside Git. Publish only small sanitized metrics/manifests. Verify repository privacy before each relay push.
Preserve PROTOCOL.md, locks.json and r3 evidence. A different precision criterion requires a new explicit protocol version and full-task design; do not silently accept r3 or adjust .03.
No model training, no test-set selection, no paid resources. Existing SSH/Git authorization remains valid; do not ask again for routine authorized operations.

Reuse runtime/pkgs and previously authorized read-only MemLoop torch path. All GPU accesses restricted to locked UUID. Existing complete model paths runtime/models/P1,P2,P4.
experiment_commands: Inspect task/service identity and project budget; write preflight manifest. Stop before GPU initialization if resource gate fails. Record versions, TF32/backend settings and exact weight hashes without changing attention backend.

Repair evaluator to fail immediately on NaN, token mismatch, resource failure and unexpected gate failure, preserving partial evidence. Save metrics after each model; ensure independent FP32 diagnosis is a separate explicit mode and does not overwrite failed smoke.json.

Require tokenizer file manifests, vocabulary maps and full validation-corpus encodings to match across P1/P2/P4. Hash actual diagnostic token bytes separately from parent block hash; record dtype/shape/endian and input/target hashes.

Implement explicit --out diagnostics for FP32 and BF16 full/prefill/incremental paths on both fixed sequences and prefill lengths. Save raw reference/path arrays remotely with manifests for independent reviewer computation; record target log-probabilities, loss differences and worst-error coordinate with both logits, local BF16 spacing and FP32 reference. Do not infer all errors from unrelated global maximum logit magnitude.

Implement full-stage paired contiguous-block bootstrap (2000 paired resamples, seed20261021, sum NLL/sum tokens in each resample) and separate generation timing per PROTOCOL.md, but do not run full/test. CPU checks must include unequal block lengths to detect mean-of-means errors and a paired-effect fixture. Validation-only generation check uses 128 prompt tokens, 32 greedy new tokens, EOS stopping consistently disabled, synchronized timing and raw repeats; do not label this test performance.

Commit changes before meaningful small validation/CPU checks, run the bounded diagnostic matrix and preserve errors. Expected BF16 .03 failures are recorded diagnostic outcomes; NaN/OOM/token/resource mismatch stop the affected task immediately without repeated retries.
Write report.json, actual command-to-SHA mapping, resource ledger and small evidence; stop for review. Do not automatically start full evaluation.

budget.model_cost_limit: One existing-provider DSH session <=1740s, no purchase/top-up. This budget is a ceiling within remaining project <=6 active hours and <=4GPUh, not an addition. Reconcile earlier runs and stop at earlier remaining limit.

stop_conditions: Runtime1740s wrapper/1800s systemd, task GPU .25h, project active6h/GPU4h, process16GiB or project new disk25GiB reached; delivery remains 2026-10-22T12:00:00+08:00.
Insufficient shared GPU free memory/utilization, new interference, OOM, NaN, weight mismatch or tokenizer/data mismatch: preserve evidence and stop; do not affect unrelated processes.
Any need to change model/dataset/split/attention backend or scientific acceptance criteria: report for review rather than silently changing it.
